subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should Control UI stop for a selected non-global channel session intentionally discard that session’s queued followup and lane work via the new opt-in `clearQueued` Gateway behavior?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately additive and documented, but choosing whether a visible stop action cancels queued user work is a durable product and protocol contract rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept selected-session queue discard
options.body: Treat Control UI `/stop` as cancellation of both the active selected channel run and its queued successor work, while preserving all callers that omit `clearQueued`.

options.title: Interrupt active work only
options.body: Remove the UI opt-in and retain queue preservation until a separate product decision defines cancellation semantics for queued channel work.

recommendation.title: Accept selected-session queue discard
recommendation.body: Treat Control UI `/stop` as cancellation of both the active selected channel run and its queued successor work, while preserving all callers that omit `clearQueued`.
